svg.title: Shuukan public landing page responsive mockup
svg.desc: A full-page desktop mockup and a mobile responsive mockup show Shuukan's public landing page: fixed navigation, asymmetric hero, real-world capture learning loop, collection tree, signup call to action, and footer.
svg.text: Public landing page — responsive layout contract
The complete unauthenticated route, documented before the global mockup palette revision.

text.tspan: Keep the Japanese
you notice.
Turn signs, menus, and everyday discoveries into a small learning habit.
Shuukan remembers where a word came from, then brings it back
when you have a minute.

g.text: Free while Shuukan is in early access. No card required.

text.tspan: Your surroundings
become the syllabus.
No blank deck to configure and no pile of generic
vocabulary. Every item starts with something you chose
to understand.
Point Shuukan at a menu, station sign, or screen.
It finds the Japanese already living in your day.
Choose the words that matter. Context and reading
stay attached, so they never become anonymous cards.
Focused prompts return later. Each answer moves the
kanji through the roots, trunk, and canopy.

g.text: A map of what is sticking

text.tspan: Watch familiarity
take root.
Shuukan’s tree is not decoration. New kanji begin at the
roots, move through the trunk as recall strengthens, and
reach the canopy when they become familiar.

g.text: START WITH ONE THING YOU SAW TODAY

text.tspan: Build a Japanese habit
that belongs to your life.

svg.text: Layout contract: fixed public navigation, left-aligned split hero at desktop, strict single-column mobile collapse, one dominant signup action, and artwork that remains visually independent from UI theme tokens.
